topic: Review of problematic German sensor data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on several problematic digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) sensors in Germany, specifically listing five locations with low or questionable data quality. Two sensors were identified as having very little data, and three others showed traffic significantly lower than expected.

It was decided that someone named Anatoly would visit the sites in Germany to inspect the equipment, potentially fixing issues at the two most problematic locations and one from the second group.

The team planned a follow-up inspection of packet counts and signal strength. One participant confirmed they would visit site #3 (JCD_DE_120848) first thing the next day around 11:00 AM.
decisions: Anatoly will visit Germany to inspect problematic sensors and attempt repairs.
The team agreed to re-verify packet counts at the sites.
A follow-up inspection of signal strength and internal equipment photos is required.
action_items: Someone needs to find/confirm addresses for the listed sensor IDs.
Participant [p2] will visit site #3 (JCD_DE_120848) around 11:00 AM the next day.
The team must measure signal strength and document internal equipment condition at problematic sites.
